limitations: Target verifier independently proves closed slot, all possible callback targets, claimed register preservation and witness applicability; common tool checks contained hash-bound bytes and actual per-side owner/site/slot/memory/instruction/IAT binding.
Callback remains opaque and present in other_unresolved_calls. Contract cannot add imports or seed tracked register values.
Graph equality alone compares target sets; strict register resolution plus exact target report inventory verifies all8cached+10direct+2opaque original vs18direct+2opaque rebuilt.
Full feature timing includes extra qualified import/dataflow/provenance/site checks; flag-off baseline is a different workload, not a claimed speed improvement.
